changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0081. Device tokens, delivery receipts, and notification preferences for Expo push. Existing app.Notifications stays the history record. Index review: PK_PushDevices; UX_PushDevices_User_Installation so one installation updates in place; UX_PushDevices_ActiveToken so a live token belongs to one account; IX_PushDevices_User_Tenant_Active for recipient lookup; PK_PushDeliveries; UX_PushDeliveries_Notification_Device to stop duplicate sends; IX_PushDeliveries_Status_UpdatedAt for receipt polling; PK_NotificationPreferences; UX_Notifications_Dedup for one history row per event. Performance note: dispatch reads active devices for one user and a small page of accepted tickets.
